name: colperm
expr: p = colperm(A); p2 = colperm(A2); p3 = colperm(A3); p4 = colperm(A4);
comment: colperm — column permutation sorted by ascending nonzero count, stable on ties. Documented for sparse matrices but works on any 2-D dense matrix (entry != 0 counts as nonzero). Output is a row vector of 1-indexed column indices.
